description: This Java class extends PropertiesCondition and overrides the matches method to check if interest, principal, penalties, and fees transaction processing are enabled in Fineract properties. It is part of the loan account starter package within the Fineract project.

classes.name: InterestPrincipalPenaltiesFeesLoanRepaymentScheduleTransactionProcessorCondition
classes.description: A condition class that checks if interest, principal, penalties, and fees processing is enabled in the Fineract properties.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Overrides the superclass method to determine if the specific transaction processor feature is enabled in the properties.
